captureJournal.recoveryCaveat: Approx. 9 seconds capture interrupted by navigation. Only the decodable committed prefix is promised; final uncommitted/container-tail audio can be lost.

limitations: Speech recognition/translation are approximate; real compressed fixture still sometimes recognizes Read as Red.
